summary: FROZEN-RECIPE OOM: the frozen C0 rasterizer's intersect_tile requires ~45.86 GiB (visN=757119 x (n_tiles+1)=6.18e9 uint32) plus ~69.15 GiB of per-Gaussian state; peak ~71 GiB on a 79.25 GiB A100 leaves only ~9.5 GiB free, so the frozen 1080p render OOMs at intersect_tile before the backward state is produced. Empirically: 720p renders OK (peak 65.64 GiB); 1080p OOMs (deterministic). This is a frozen-rasterizer memory-capacity limitation, NOT a bug in the revised kit (the algebra, raw-frame adjoint, and bucket walk are all correct and were verified synthetically).

oom_evidence.error: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 45.86 GiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 79.25 GiB of which 9.50 GiB is free. Process has 69.74 GiB memory in use. Of the allocated memory 69.15 GiB is allocated by PyTorch.
oom_evidence.n_attempts: tried GPUs 0,1,2,3,5,7 (co-tenant-independent); retry-on-OOM loop exhausted; 1080p OOMs on a free GPU deterministically

why_not_a_kit_bug: Stage-0 identity: all 14 checks PASS (10 frozen-source sha MATCH, 2 kernel byte-identity BYTE-IDENTICAL, ckpt b31e5a6b.. MATCH, cam19 DSCF4819 MATCH).

The revised algebra (q_color=fac*v_render_colors, T init T_final, native tile x batch buckets, corrected Common.h constants) was verified bit-identical to the frozen analyzer and matched an independent hand computation synthetically.
The OOM is in the FROZEN C0 rasterizer (intersect_tile), reached BEFORE the raw-frame adjoint / bucket walk / SVD ever execute; it is independent of the revised code path.
The frozen training itself peaked at 1.57 GiB only because peak_vram_gb is measured mid-training (post-densification, lower N); the 841K checkpoint is the densest state and is the one P10 targets.
what_this_does_not_block: The exact-backward algebra gate (Stage 1) -- PASS (q_alpha, q_color exact, real 3-channel, T_init=T_final, H8_MR independence documented).
what_would_unblock: Run the exact frozen recipe on a GPU with >= ~120 GiB HBM (A100-40GB is insufficient; H100-80GB or A100-80GB with a smaller N_visible / tile config may fit), OR

Reduce the effective N_visible (e.g., the frozen culling path is already active; a higher radius_clip / tighter eps2d would change the FROZEN recipe and is NOT permitted by the P10 stop discipline), OR
Capture the native backward state via the frozen _native_backward path on a host where the 1080p intersect_tile fits (a larger-HBM A100/H100).
